pkg.desc: The built-in PKG Manager is a separate daemon with its own UI (port 8844) that installs PKGs from USB / disc / SMB shares. The "PKG Install" sidebar item starts it automatically and takes you straight to its UI.
pkg.frame_first_run: First start may take a few seconds
pkg.frame_fail_hint: Make sure elfldr is running on port 9021; you can also check the PKG Manager card on the Settings page.
pkg.launch_ok: Launch command sent, first start takes a few seconds
pkg.stop_hint: Stop the PKG Manager daemon (you can start it again anytime)
pkg.upload_ok: Uploaded v{{ver}}, takes effect after restarting PKG Manager
pkg.upload_hint: Updates are manual: open this page from a desktop browser and select a newer pkg-manager ELF. Uploads are validated (ELF header + version signature) and committed atomically; the embedded baseline is an offline fallback and never overwrites an uploaded file.
entries.title: Quick Links
entries.desc: Quick-access list for common plugins and LAN services (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8844). Entries are stored on the console, so phone / desktop / PS5 all see the same list; a green dot means the address is currently reachable. Http tile links of installed apps are imported automatically (marked "Auto"); once you delete one it will not come back. Clicking a green entry opens it in a new tab; clicking a grey one starts the matching installed program first when there is one (no hard-coded program list) and then opens it in a new tab as well, so this page is never replaced. Entries with no matching program just open as a normal link.
entries.name: Name
entries.url_hint: Scheme may be omitted (defaults to http://); write https:// explicitly when needed.
entries.empty: No entries yet. Click "Add Entry" to get started.
entries.start_timeout: Launch was requested but the port never came up
entries.already_running: This program looks like it is already running, but the address is not reachable from here (it may only listen on 127.0.0.1)
entries.tab_blocked: The program is up, but the browser blocked the new tab. Click this entry once more to open it
settings.theme_desc: Choose dark or light interface; "Auto" follows your system preference.
settings.donate_desc: This is a fork maintained by naye, based on the original Payload Manager by itsPLK (v{{version}}). If you like it, you can buy the original author a coffee.
donate.description: If you like this project, you can support the original author. Thank you very much!
donate.fork_desc: This is a fork of Payload Manager maintained by {{maintainer}}.
donate.fork_donate_note: Donations through the button above go to the original author (itsPLK), not this fork.
donate.ref_desc: Changes in this fork were informed by the open-source projects below, each attributed to its author with the exact source location.
app.offline.title: NayePlmTools is not running...
settings.changelog_desc: View version update history for this fork.
settings.archive_desc: Configure default auto-save and local snapshot parameters.
settings.archive_config_hint: The three things set here apply to all games: the remote location, the auto-save toggles/timings, and the local snapshot toggle/copy limit. Each game's Save manager only displays them and acts (Pull now / Push now / Snapshot now) — it does not configure them again.
settings.default_repo_desc: The built-in official payload catalog. Turning it off stops every request to it, including the startup refresh; your own sources keep working.
settings.default_repo_off_hint: Default repository is off and multi-source mode is disabled: the Manage tab only lists local payloads. Turn on Multiple Payload Sources to use your own repositories.
storage_hub.repo_disabled_desc: The default cloud repository is turned off in Settings, so no online payload catalog is fetched. Turn it back on to browse and install online payloads.
manage_sources.empty: No sources yet — add one below
manage_sources.pc_hint_title: Or manage from a phone or PC
acctools.title: Accounts / Remote Play Pairing
acctools.desc: Offline activation and sign-in state of the foreground account, its Account ID in three formats, and the Remote Play pairing PIN. Every registry value is copied before it is written, so Sign out rolls exactly that batch back.
acctools.no_foreground: No foreground account — sign into an account on the console, then refresh
acctools.no_foreground_desc: sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser failed or nobody is signed in. Sign into an account on the console, then hit Refresh.
acctools.signin_tip: Sign this account in to the system
acctools.signout_tip: Sign out only; the account stays activated, so you can sign in again without re-activating
acctools.activate_tip: Write the offline activation info — required before signing in
acctools.signout_head_pend: Sign {{name}} out: only the {{n}} original value(s) recorded under its name{{slot}} are rolled back; other accounts' pending records stay untouched.
acctools.signout_head_none: Sign {{name}} out{{slot}}: this tool holds no record for it, so the current sign-in was not written by us. The measured baseline for "activated, offline" will be written back, and auth.dat / config.dat are copied into the backup layer before removal (every value is copied first, so Restore can put them back).
acctools.hex_converted: Converted; this account is not activated — pressing Activate will write this ID into the registry
acctools.hex_same: Matches the console; Base64 / decimal converted from it
acctools.acct_hint: This card is bound to the current foreground account (the PIN is too) — to work on another account, switch to it on the console and refresh.
acctools.pending_records: This tool still owes it {{n}} original value record(s).
acctools.avatar_tip: Click to upload an avatar (or drop an image here)
acctools.crop_hint: Drag to reposition, scroll or pinch to zoom. It uploads cropped to the square frame.
acctools.crop_load_fail: This image can't be read (unsupported format or corrupt file)
acctools.not_image: Please pick an image file (PNG / JPG / WebP)
acctools.noblob: Crop failed: could not export image data
acctools.upload_timeout: Avatar upload timed out (no response from the console in 30 s) — it may be stuck converting or writing the image. Please retry.
acctools.pin_none: No PIN yet — use the button below to generate one
acctools.pin_hint: The PIN is only valid for the current foreground account and is the same code the console shows under Settings → System → Remote Play → Pair with Device; it is valid for 3 minutes, then the session is closed automatically.
acctools.pin_waiting: Status: waiting for pairing, enter PIN + Account ID on the client.
acctools.pin_resumed: Resumed the pairing in progress: {{sec}} s left
game.auto_enable_hint: When on, the console syncs this game's saves with the remote location at the timings below.
game.auto_on_exit_hint: Upload the console's saves to the remote location
game.auto_on_launch_hint: Download the remote saves to the console, overwriting the local ones
game.bg_desc: The backdrop of the whole card. The console converts it to a 1920×1080 DDS. On a tile the icon sits on top of it, so it only shows around the icon and behind the text.
game.bg_limit: PNG / JPEG supported; resized to 1920×1080 (centre-cropped to 16:9) before upload, then converted to DDS on the console.
game.bg_reset_fail: Failed to restore the default backdrop
game.icon_desc: Replaces the game cover. Centre-cropped to 1:1 on the short edge; the preview is the square you see on the tile.
game.icon_limit: PNG / JPEG supported; resized to a 1024×1024 PNG before upload.
game.icon_reset_fail: Failed to restore the default icon
game.busy: The console is busy right now, please try again later
game.delete_bg: The deletion keeps running on the console in the background; refresh the list later to see the result
game.delete_confirm:
Permanently delete the physical source of "{{name}}"?

This cannot be undone.
game.delete_hint: "Delete source" permanently removes the physical image or folder itself. To make it disappear from the console while keeping the files, use "Uninstall".
game.delete_missing: The source no longer exists; a rescan has been queued
game.delete_running_hint: The deletion is running; closing this window will not interrupt the task on the console.
game.empty: No installed or existing games found
game.media_hint: Click a thumbnail to preview it; click the box in its top-left corner to add it to the packing list. Packing runs in the background on the console, so you can close this window.
game.no_media: This game has no screenshots or videos yet
game.no_shots: This game has no screenshots yet
game.no_videos: This game has no recordings / videos yet
game.not_found: This game was not found on the console
game.smp_hint: This panel is read-only. Mount, uninstall and delete-source are handled in ShadowMount.
game.smp_waiting: Launch sent, waiting for the port to come up
game.smp_start_timeout: Launch was sent, but the port never came up
game.smp_not_installed: ShadowMountPlus was not found on this console; install it first to open it from here.
game.pending_desc: Nothing has been decided for this slot yet. Every option below is achievable with the capabilities we already have — pick one, or just tell me what you have in mind.
game.perm_denied: This game has no physical source that can be deleted
game.pkg_no_source: This is an installed PKG with no physical source file; it lives only on the console's system storage.
game.ph_secret: leave blank to keep it unchanged
game.rename_hint: Only the display name changes. The title ID ({{tid}}) is untouched, and saves and launching are unaffected.
game.save_delete_confirm: Delete all saves of this game under user "{{uid}}"? This cannot be undone.
game.save_hint: One row = one user's complete save for this game (including the console's own _bu_ backups). Download and upload both move the whole zip; uploading replaces it entirely.
game.garlic_wrong_game: This save belongs to {{other}}, not the current game ({{tid}}) — import it from that game instead.
game.garlic_hint: Imports an encrypted save exported by garlic-savemgr: on PS5 a single sdimg_ image file (no extension), on PS4 a zip. Only same-named images are overwritten; the console's own backups and system save are left alone.
game.garlic_import_confirm: Import "{{name}}" into {{target}}? Only same-named save images are overwritten; the console's own backups (_bu_) and system save are kept.
game.saves_empty: This game has no saves yet
game.stage_fail: Could not read that image, please try another one
game.secret_saved: Already saved; leave blank to keep it unchanged
game.snap_enable_hint: No network needed: after each game exits the console copies the whole save to local /data and prunes the oldest beyond the keep count. This is the last line of defence when remote sync is unreachable.
game.snap_keep_hint: Keep at most this many copies per save; the oldest is pruned (1-20).
game.snap_hint: One row = one user's complete save at a point in time. Restore overwrites the current save with it (rolling back if the swap fails); Delete removes only the snapshot, never the save itself. Nothing new is added while the save is unchanged, so the count grows slowly.
game.snap_restore_confirm: Overwrite user "{{uid}}"'s current save with the snapshot from {{time}}? The current one will be replaced (rolled back automatically if the swap fails).
game.snap_delete_confirm: Delete the snapshot from {{time}}? Only the snapshot is removed; the console's current save is untouched. This cannot be undone.
game.mode_unsupported: Only SMB is supported right now. FTP / HTTP are temporarily disabled (coming later).
game.mode_unsupported_toast: Only SMB is supported — FTP / HTTP are temporarily disabled
game.running_hint: This game is running right now; if auto-upload on exit is on, saves will be pushed when you quit
game.running_no_sync: The game is running; quit it before pushing or pulling saves.
game.tile_hint: Click a tile to open the game's details (read-only: mount, uninstall and delete-source are handled in ShadowMount). The four buttons on a tile are Saves, Media, Name & artwork, and Coming soon.
game.title: Game manager
game.tile_apply_hint: New image ready — click Apply to write it to the console.
game.tile_pick_hint: You can also click the image to pick a file
game.truncated: The list is too large and has been truncated
game.uninstall_confirm:
Request uninstall for "{{name}}"?

The source image or folder will not be deleted.
game.uninstall_ok: Uninstall requested; the console will finish it in the background
game.uninstall_pkg_confirm: Uninstall "{{name}}"? The installed PKG game will be deleted.
game.sync_names_hint: Rewrite every name you changed in this panel to the console: first the console index (app.db / appinfo.db — this is what ShadowMount and the TV home screen read), then, for folder / LZ4 titles, the game source param.json once more. Use it after renaming on an older build, or after a ShadowMount rescan pushed the names back; titles that already match are not rewritten.
game.remote_unset: No remote location configured yet — set it in Settings → Archive Config.
game.remote_global_hint: The toggles above and the remote location are set once in Settings → Archive Config; that setting applies to all games.
game.remote_no_local: No local saves yet — cannot locate the remote user
game.remote_no_save: No remote save for this user yet
settings.auto_enable_hint_global: When on, the console auto-syncs every game's saves with the remote location at the timings below. Applies to all games.
settings.snap_enable_hint_global: Needs no network: after each game exits the console copies the save into local /data and prunes the oldest beyond the copy limit. When remote sync cannot connect, this is the last fallback. Applies to all games.
game.snap_global_hint: Snapshot toggles and parameters are set once in Settings → Archive Config and apply to all games. A snapshot is taken automatically after each game exits.
